003_i: Something is stirring in your neighborhood. Can you feel it?
006_div: One of the four protagonist paths at IN
008_h2: A young person who senses that more is possible — and is willing to find out what that might look like.
009_p: In their neighborhood, in their community, in themselves. Not a leader with all the answers. Not an expert with a plan. A BridgeBuilder is someone who is curious enough to ask deeper questions, humble enough to listen carefully, and brave enough to try something — together with their neighbors.
011_h2: Your journey unfolds over one year — and it begins not with a project but with a question about yourself.
012_p: You will move through three stages. Each one opens with a session in the same workshop series — the briefs below are examples of what those sessions look like.
016_p: What assumptions do I carry about the people around me? What keeps neighbors strangers to each other? You will practice conversations that go deeper than usual — and discover what is hidden beneath the visible surface of your neighborhood.
022_p: What is already alive here that no one has yet named? You will learn to see your neighborhood not from what is missing but from what is quietly, stubbornly present — and begin to imagine what becomes possible when youth activate it.
028_p: You will design and co-facilitate a ME=WE Pop-Up Lab — a neighborhood activation rooted in what you discovered, created together with neighbors, friends, and like-minded people in your community.
031_p: Along the way, you will connect with BridgeBuilders in other neighborhoods and other countries — sharing what you are learning, witnessing each other’s neighborhoods, and discovering that the longing for connection you feel is shared across cultures and borders.
032_div: What is a ME=WE Pop-Up Lab?
033_h2: An artful invitation, not an event.
034_p: A space where neighbors encounter each other, perhaps for the first time, through creative expression, meaningful conversation, and shared action.
035_p: What it looks like depends on where you are and what your community needs. It might be a music gathering, a storytelling circle, a dialogue space, an intergenerational exchange, or something entirely new.
036_b: The form is yours. The root system is shared.
038_h2: You — if you are a young person between 18 and 35 who:
039_p: Senses that something more is possible in your neighborhood
040_p: Is willing to begin with honest self-discovery
041_p: Can commit to one year of practice, reflection, and action
042_p: Wants to be part of something larger than one city or one country
043_p: You do not need prior experience in community work, facilitation, or social innovation. You need curiosity, sincerity, and a willingness to show up — for your neighbors, and for yourself.
044_div: What you will be part of
045_h2: The beginning of a living ecosystem.
046_p: BridgeBuilders work in their own neighborhoods and stay connected to each other across countries. It is a careful attempt to create conditions for something that, if it takes root, will continue to grow and co-evolve long after any one year ends.
047_p: What you learn, what you document, and what you create becomes part of the ME=WE Neighborhood Archive — a living resource that others can build upon, in contexts and communities you may never meet but will have quietly touched.

052_p: For creativity. For genuine encounters. For rediscovered neighborhoods.
